description: M0/D-357 — the BROWSER_MEDIATED realization (D-338 engineering): holds the browser session as FIXTURE-recorded captures (in-sandbox; the CDP leg is owner-machine-only future work and never silently simulated). Sends pass four fail-closed bars: day-one fence holds (law.forbidden.set@1 registered at onInit), session attached, realization PROMOTED through discovery.verify@1's standard lifecycle, and a verified parser pin covers the manifest parser version (D-355). The send replay emits ordered M1 chunks via meta.emit (D-352 discipline) and lands the message ns 'email' pack-schema-exact. Captures run through credential.redact@1 BEFORE the vault sees them (M12/D-356 ordering law).

provider.doc: attach {captureText, archetypeSlug?, parserVersion?} → {sessionId, captureRef, redactions, integrity, rev} — redact-before-vault (credential.redact@1), then append the capture row (ns providers, capture:<uuid>) and the session row (session:<uuid>, BY REFERENCE ONLY, sim: true). Parser version must match the manifest's (fail-closed genealogy).
release {sessionId} → {sessionId, status: 'RELEASED', rev} — appends the release revision; a released session fails bar 2 on every later send.

send {sessionId, to, subject, body, threadId?} → {messageId, rev, sentAt, chunks} plus live-only providerMessageId. The pack contract remains message.send@1 / EXTERNAL_MUTATION. A fixture session replays the pinned capture; a live session executes against ChatGPT through localhost CDP, preserving four bars, exact outgoing body verification, one submit click, SSE capture/parse, ordered M1 chunks, and the existing ns 'email' pack-schema-exact outbound record.

parser.doc: D-355 (M7): the version-pinned parser for the message.send archetype — NOT routable (parser kind registers no op). The pure deterministic transform accepts either the historical recorded-capture JSON or the live ChatGPT SSE response and emits ordered ParsedChunk rows. The same v1 pin therefore covers the fixture replay and the real ChatGPT send path.

capabilities.justification: Session/capture/message rows persist in the USER'S VAULT (data/code divorce) via port:vault.append@1 + port:vault.get@1. Captures are redacted BEFORE storage via port:credential.redact@1 — an output-only surface that cannot reveal secrets (it never returns them; M12/D-356). The day-one fence registers never-invocations via port:law.forbidden.set@1 (D-338 law-reviewed authority). The browser NEVER requests port:credential.use@1 — the fence denies it to the pilot principal on day one, and the plugin holds no such capability.
